description.en: Baked filled buns associated with Naga and Libmanan.

text.en: The buns are baked, rather than steamed.
GMC traces early Naga versions to Naga Garden and Romero’s Bakery in the 1970s.
The Sta. Maria family expanded production through 3N Bakery in the 1990s.
A Naga food guide records 3N’s Libmanan origin claim, alongside the early Naga accounts.

sources.title: Langyaw: Where to eat in Naga (2016)
